QA-31572 **PASS**. The Brand Insights Impressions number is 188,000,285, and the three Time Window Comparison channel values add up to exactly that, with a difference of 0.

- **Insights side:** Amazon Prime Video (Authorized), Facebook, Twitter and Instagram only, Oct 12–18, 2026.
- **Time Window Comparison side:** I added the same brand on Authorized and ran it with Absolute Dates, Aggregate and By Channel. The channel values were:
  - Facebook Page Impressions: 97,157,423
  - Twitter Organic Post Impressions: 7,732,834
  - Instagram Post Impressions: 83,110,028
- **"Classic Reporting":** the Reporting menu has no item with that name, so I used Time Window Comparison. The earlier QA-30670 and QA-30666 runs did the same.
- **Toggle quirk:** flipping the Insights Public/Authorized toggle reset the channels to all four. It also left a stale set of tiles with no Impressions tile. I re-selected the channels and reloaded, and the reload gave the same 188,000,285 as the first read. I noted this in the report and did not file it.
- **Known bugs:** no open linked bugs and no bug-history entries for this case.

Report: `results/2026-10-20/QA-31572-report.md`; screenshots are in `.playwright-out/QA-31572/`. I did no skill or registry maintenance, as instructed.
